duties.quote: Every week client der sathe relationship calls thake, mostly Sunday ar Monday, eta office theke kori.
Protiti Tuesday sondha 6 ta theke 7:30 porjonto credit pre-meeting hoy, oikhane ami amar clients er loan proposals present kori.
Mashe ekbar Chattogram jai, oikhane amar tin ta client er factory visit korte hoy, usually two days lage.
Ar mash sheshe ekta portfolio report CFO office e pathai, eta ghore bose o kora jay.

Haan, clients C, D ar E er trade finance renewals April er 10 tarikh er moddhe due. Oder statements gula shudhu amar email e ache. Rafiq bhai cover korbe bole plan, kintu uni ei client der sathe kokhono kaj koren ni.
